questions.question: Microsoft Azure is best described as which of the following?

options.text: A public cloud computing platform offering services such as compute, storage, networking and AI
options.why: Correct. Azure is Microsoft's public cloud platform.

options.text: A version of the Windows operating system
options.why: Azure is a cloud platform. It runs Windows and Linux workloads.
That is Microsoft 365, a SaaS product, not Azure.

options.text: A hardware server that companies buy and install on-premises
options.why: Azure is consumed as a service from Microsoft's datacenters.

questions.explanation: Azure is Microsoft's public cloud platform with more than 200 services that you consume on demand.

questions.question: Which tool lets you create and manage Azure resources from a web browser using a graphical interface?

options.why: Azure CLI is a command-line tool, not a graphical interface.
Correct. The Azure portal is the browser-based graphical console.
Data Box is a physical device for transferring large amounts of data.
Purview is for data governance, not general resource management.

questions.explanation: The Azure portal (portal.azure.com) is the web-based GUI for managing Azure.

questions.question: Which operating systems can you run on Azure virtual machines?

options.why: Azure supports Linux as well. A large share of Azure VMs run Linux.
Windows Server and Windows client images are also available.
Correct. Azure supports many Windows and Linux images.

options.text: Neither. Azure only runs web apps
options.why: Azure offers full IaaS virtual machines.

questions.explanation: Azure supports Windows and many Linux distributions.

questions.question: Every request to create, update or delete an Azure resource, whether from the portal, CLI or PowerShell, is processed by which service?

options.why: Correct. ARM is the deployment and management layer for all management requests.
Azure Monitor collects telemetry. It does not process deployments.
Advisor gives recommendations and does not process requests.

questions.explanation: Azure Resource Manager (ARM) receives, authenticates and authorises all management requests, so every tool gets consistent results.
